name: @avatark/navigation
description: Shared cross-product navigation contract: viewer-state vocabulary, 'next product' resolution, the Redirect Manager (return/callback/preview/production domain helpers -- no product hard-codes another's URL), the Product Switcher's canonical entry-building API, and the Deep Link Resolver (watch/practice/echo/arena/studio/game). InstitutionalHeader/EchoHeader/EchoAvatarMenu/AdminNav remain separate, unmigrated UI implementations, and the 'return to Avatar' decision (lib/journey/continuity.ts) stays app-specific, not packaged, since it depends on this app's own intention/witness content.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
